statusResting.zh-Hans: 休息中 · 还剩 %d 秒

restEmptyLibrary.en: No scenes available — add background images in Settings
restEmptyLibrary.zh-Hans: 素材库为空，可在设置里添加背景图片

restSkipUnlockIn.zh-Hans: 跳过将在 %d 秒后可用

aboutCodeLicense.en: Code released under the MIT license.
aboutCodeLicense.zh-Hans: 代码以 MIT 许可发布。

aboutPhotoNote.en: The built-in photos come from Wikimedia Commons. Each keeps its own license — the code license above does not cover them.
aboutPhotoNote.zh-Hans: 内置风景照来自 Wikimedia Commons，各自适用其原始许可 —— 上面的代码许可不覆盖它们。

helpLanguage.en: The interface and the photo descriptions follow the same setting.
helpLanguage.zh-Hans: 界面与图片介绍都跟随这一项。

helpSkipUnlock.en: The delay before Skip appears is deliberate: skipping should cost a little resolve. A frictionless skip is no reminder at all.
helpSkipUnlock.zh-Hans: 跳过按钮延迟出现，是为了让「跳过」需要一点决心 —— 完全无摩擦的跳过等于没有提醒。

helpTestMode.en: Unlocks 1/2/5-minute intervals and 5/10-second breaks, and shortens the wake cooldown to 5 seconds, so the whole "auto-trigger" path can run a full cycle in about a minute. Leave it off for normal use — a reminder every minute is harassment, not eye care.
helpTestMode.zh-Hans: 解锁 1/2/5 分钟的间隔与 5/10 秒的休息时长，唤醒冷却缩短到 5 秒，让「自动触发」这条核心路径能在一分多钟内跑完一轮。正常使用时请关闭 —— 1 分钟提醒一次是骚扰，不是护眼。

helpIdleThreshold.en: Once you've been idle for this long it counts as "already rested", and the timer resets.
helpIdleThreshold.zh-Hans: 空闲达到阈值会被视为「已经休息过」，计时器重置。

toggleSuppressFullscreen.zh-Hans: 全屏应用 / 演示中顺延

toggleSuppressCamera.en: Suppress while the camera is in use (in a meeting)
toggleSuppressCamera.zh-Hans: 摄像头被占用（会议中）顺延

helpFullscreen.en: Detected as "the window's top edge covers the menu bar and it matches the screen size". A maximised window is not mistaken for fullscreen.
helpFullscreen.zh-Hans: 判定为「窗口顶边覆盖菜单栏且尺寸与屏幕一致」。最大化窗口不会被误判为全屏。

helpWakeCooldown.en: After waking from sleep or unlocking, reminders wait at least %d seconds before they can fire.
helpWakeCooldown.zh-Hans: 从休眠唤醒或解锁后，至少等待 %d 秒才允许触发提醒。

helpDoNotDisturb.en: macOS has no public API for Do Not Disturb / Focus, so this version doesn't use it as an automatic signal. Use "Pause" in the menu bar instead.
helpDoNotDisturb.zh-Hans: 「勿扰 / 专注模式」在 macOS 上没有公开 API，本版本不作为自动判断依据，请使用菜单栏的「暂停」。

helpNightDimming.en: At night the scene is dimmed and bright scenes are avoided, so a sudden full-screen white flash doesn't hit your eyes.
helpNightDimming.zh-Hans: 夜间会压暗画面并避开高亮度素材，避免突然的全屏白亮刺激。

assetsNoneWarning.en: No scenes are enabled. The break screen will fall back to a plain colour — the reminder still works, there's just no picture.
assetsNoneWarning.zh-Hans: 没有任何可用素材。休息画面会退化成纯色背景 —— 提醒照常，只是没有配图。

assetsAllBundledInfo.en: You're using only the landscape photos shipped with the app. Use the buttons below to import your own images.
assetsAllBundledInfo.zh-Hans: 当前全部使用随 App 分发的预置风景照。点下面的按钮可以导入你自己的图片。

assetsAllPlaceholderInfo.en: You're using only the procedurally generated placeholder scenes (abstract colour blocks). Use the buttons below to import your own images.
assetsAllPlaceholderInfo.zh-Hans: 当前全部使用程序化生成的占位场景（抽象色块）。点下面的按钮导入你自己的图片。

assetsMixedSummaryBundled.en: Imported %d images; %d bundled landscape photos are also in rotation.
assetsMixedSummaryBundled.zh-Hans: 已导入 %d 张图片，另有 %d 张预置风景照在轮播中。

assetsMixedSummaryPlaceholder.en: Imported %d images; %d placeholder scenes are also in rotation.
assetsMixedSummaryPlaceholder.zh-Hans: 已导入 %d 张图片，另有 %d 张占位场景在轮播中。

assetsDisabledBuiltInFlash.en: Built-in scenes are off — only your own images will rotate
assetsDisabledBuiltInFlash.zh-Hans: 已关闭内置场景，现在只轮播你的图片

assetsImportFormatsHelp.en: Supports JPG / PNG / HEIC / WebP / TIFF / BMP / GIF. Images wider than 2560 pixels are downsampled automatically, so the library doesn't grow for no reason.
assetsImportFormatsHelp.zh-Hans: 支持 JPG / PNG / HEIC / WebP / TIFF / BMP / GIF。超过 2560 像素的图会自动降采样，避免素材库无谓地变大。

assetsBuiltInRealPhotosHelp.en: %d real landscape photos shipped with the app (from Wikimedia Commons; see each image's original page for its licence). Enable or disable by category — the category is the unit the picker uses to avoid showing two similar scenes in a row.
assetsBuiltInRealPhotosHelp.zh-Hans: 随 App 分发的 %d 张真实风景照（来源 Wikimedia Commons，许可见各图原始页面）。按类别启用/禁用 —— 类别是选片算法保证「相邻两次画面不雷同」的单位。

assetsBuiltInPlaceholdersHelp.en: Procedurally generated placeholder scenes, used to exercise the whole flow before any real scenes are available. Enable or disable by category — the category is the unit the picker uses to avoid showing two similar scenes in a row.
assetsBuiltInPlaceholdersHelp.zh-Hans: 程序化生成的占位场景，用来在还没有真实素材时跑通流程。按类别启用/禁用 —— 类别是选片算法保证「相邻两次画面不雷同」的单位。

assetsPickFolderPanel.en: Choose a folder containing background images
assetsPickFolderPanel.zh-Hans: 选择包含背景图片的文件夹

assetsPickFolderNote.en: Only images directly inside this folder are taken; subfolders are not scanned.
assetsPickFolderNote.zh-Hans: 只取这个文件夹里直接包含的图片，不会递归子文件夹

assetsWriteFailed.en: Could not write to the scene library: %@

assetsCategoryPromptTitle.en: Which category should these images belong to?

assetsCategoryPromptHelp.en: The category keeps two consecutive scenes from looking alike. If you're not sure, pick "My Images" — you can change each one later.
assetsCategoryPromptHelp.zh-Hans: 类别用于保证相邻两次展示的画面不雷同。不确定就选「我的图片」，之后可以逐张修改。

assetsDeleteConfirmHelp.en: This also deletes the copy in the scene library. Your original file is untouched.
assetsDeleteConfirmHelp.zh-Hans: 会同时删掉素材库里这份拷贝。你原来的文件不受影响。

assetsRemoveAllConfirm.zh-Hans: 移除全部 %d 张导入的图片？

assetsRemoveAllHelp.en: Only the copies in the scene library are deleted; your original files are untouched.
assetsRemoveAllHelp.zh-Hans: 只删素材库里的拷贝，你原来的文件不受影响。

noticeSkipTitle.en: You've skipped several breaks in a row
noticeSkipTitle.zh-Hans: 你最近连续跳过了几次休息

noticeSkipBody.en: If a %d-minute interval feels too frequent, a longer interval is usually easier to stick with.
noticeSkipBody.zh-Hans: 如果 %d 分钟的间隔太频繁，把间隔调长一些通常更容易坚持下来。
